mapper.sql: purchase_orders.id AS purchaseOrderId, purchase_orders.po_code AS purchaseBillNo, purchase_requests.pr_code AS poNo, purchase_orders.invoice_code AS invoiceNo, purchase_orders.invoice_date AS invoiceDate, vendors.id AS vendorId, vendors.name AS vendorName, locations.id AS locationId, locations.name AS locationName, location_groups.id AS warehouseId, location_groups.name AS warehouseName, purchase_orders.order_date AS purchaseBillDate, purchase_receive_results.date AS purchaseReceiveDate, purchase_orders.status AS status, purchase_orders.company_id AS companyId

FROM purchase_orders LEFT JOIN locations ON locations.id = purchase_orders.location_id LEFT JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = purchase_orders.vendor_id LEFT JOIN purchase_requests ON purchase_requests.id = purchase_orders.purchase_request_id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON location_groups.id = purchase_orders.location_group_id LEFT JOIN purchase_receives ON purchase_receives.purchase_order_id = purchase_orders.id LEFT JOIN purchase_receive_results ON purchase_receive_results.purchase_order_id = purchase_orders.id
mapper.select:
SELECT purchase_receive_results.id AS id, purchase_orders.id AS purchaseOrderId, purchase_orders.po_code AS purchaseBillNo, purchase_requests.pr_code AS poNo, vendors.id AS vendorId, vendors.name AS vendorName, locations.id AS locationId, locations.name AS locationName, location_groups.id AS warehouseId, location_groups.name AS warehouseName, purchase_orders.order_date AS purchaseBillDate, purchase_receive_results.date AS purchaseReceiveDate, purchase_receive_results.code AS purchaseReceiveCode, purchase_orders.status AS status, purchase_orders.company_id AS companyId
WHERE purchase_orders.id = #{id} AND purchase_orders.status > 0 AND purchase_orders.id NOT IN ( SELECT purchase_order_id FROM purchase_receive_results WHERE status > 0 AND type = 2 AND purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL ) AND purchase_orders.company_id IN ( SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) GROUP BY purchase_receive_results.code, purchase_receive_results.date

WHERE purchase_orders.id = #{id} AND purchase_orders.status > 0 AND purchase_orders.id NOT IN ( SELECT purchase_order_id FROM purchase_receive_results WHERE status > 0 AND type = 2 AND purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL ) AND purchase_orders.company_id IN ( SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) GROUP BY purchase_orders.id

SELECT purchase_receives.id AS id, purchase_receives.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, purchase_receives.conversion AS conversion, IFNULL(purchase_receives.lots_number, '') AS lotNumber, purchase_receives.qty AS qty, purchase_receives.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uom, products.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, purchase_receives.date_expired AS dateExpired, purchase_receives.product_id AS productId, products.name AS productName, products.code AS code, products.barcode AS barcode, purchase_receives.received_date AS receiveDate, 'Accepted' AS status FROM purchase_receives LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = purchase_receives.qty_uom_id LEFT JOIN products ON purchase_receives.product_id = products.id WHERE purchase_receives.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND purchase_receives.purchase_receive_result_id = #{purchaseReceiveResultId}

SELECT purchase_receives.id AS id, purchase_receives.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, purchase_receives.conversion AS conversion, IFNULL(purchase_receives.lots_number, '') AS lotNumber, purchase_receives.qty AS qty, purchase_receives.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uom, products.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, purchase_receives.date_expired AS dateExpired, purchase_receives.product_id AS productId, products.name AS productName, products.code AS code, products.barcode AS barcode, purchase_receives.received_date AS receiveDate, 'Accepted' AS status FROM purchase_receives LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = purchase_receives.qty_uom_id LEFT JOIN products ON purchase_receives.product_id = products.id WHERE purchase_receives.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId}

SELECT purchase_order_details.id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, purchase_order_details.unit_cost AS unitCost, purchase_order_details.new_unit_cost AS newCost, IFNULL(purchase_order_details.conversion,1) AS conversion, IFNULL(purchase_order_details.lots_number, '') AS lotNumber, ((purchase_order_details.qty + purchase_order_details.qty_free) - ( SELECT SUM(qty) FROM purchase_receives WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND purchase_order_detail_id = purchase_order_details.id )) AS qty, purchase_order_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uom, products.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, purchase_order_details.date_expired AS dateExpired, purchase_order_details.product_id AS productId, products.name AS productName, products.code AS code, products.barcode AS barcode, "" AS receiveDate, 'Entered' AS status FROM purchase_order_details LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = purchase_order_details.qty_uom_id LEFT JOIN products ON purchase_order_details.product_id = products.id WHERE purchase_order_details.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND purchase_order_details.id = purchase_order_details.id HAVING qty > 0

SELECT purchase_order_details.id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, purchase_order_details.unit_cost AS unitCost, purchase_order_details.new_unit_cost AS newCost, purchase_order_details.conversion AS conversion, IFNULL(purchase_order_details.lots_number, '') AS lotNumber, purchase_order_details.qty + purchase_order_details.qty_free AS qty, purchase_order_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uom, products.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, purchase_order_details.date_expired AS dateExpired, purchase_order_details.product_id AS productId, products.name AS productName, products.code AS code, products.barcode AS barcode, "" AS receiveDate, 'Entered' AS status FROM purchase_order_details LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = purchase_order_details.qty_uom_id LEFT JOIN products ON purchase_order_details.product_id = products.id WHERE purchase_order_details.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND purchase_order_details.id NOT IN ( SELECT purchase_order_detail_id FROM purchase_receives WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_receive_results ( purchase_order_id, `type`, `code`, `date`, `status`, `created`, `created_by` ) VALUES ( #{id}, 1, #{code}, #{date}, 1, NOW(), #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM purchase_receive_results WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT purchase_order_details.purchase_order_id AS purchaseOrderId, purchase_order_details.id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, IFNULL(purchase_order_details.conversion, 1) AS conversion, IFNULL(purchase_order_details.lots_number, '0') AS lotNumber, purchase_order_details.qty AS qty, purchase_order_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uom, purchase_order_details.date_expired AS dateExpired, purchase_order_details.product_id AS productId, products.name AS productName, products.code AS code, products.unit_cost AS unitCost, products.barcode AS barcode FROM purchase_order_details LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = purchase_order_details.qty_uom_id LEFT JOIN products ON purchase_order_details.product_id = products.id WHERE purchase_order_details.purchase_order_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_receives ( purchase_receive_result_id, purchase_order_detail_id, purchase_order_id, product_id, qty, qty_uom_id, conversion, received_date, date_expired, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{purchaseReceive.purchaseReceiveResultId}, #{purchaseReceive.purchaseOrderDetailId}, #{purchaseReceive.purchaseOrderId}, #{purchaseReceive.productId}, #{purchaseReceive.qty}, #{purchaseReceive.qtyUomId}, #{purchaseReceive.conversion}, #{purchaseReceive.receivedDate}, #{purchaseReceive.dateExpired}, NOW(), #{purchaseReceive.createdBy} )
